title: Blocking property of designated persons
definition: The requirement to block, and to hold blocked, property in which a designated person has an interest, and to report it. A financial institution is expected to screen its customers and its counterparties against the designations in force, to re-screen as the lists change, and to hold rather than return property that has been blocked. This record summarises the requirement.
evidence_to_cite: the screening result, the list version used and the date of the screen
the property blocked, and the date of the block
the report made to the sanctions authority

sources.citation: Blocking of property owned or controlled by designated persons (31 CFR 501.601 and 501.603), summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
